blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — All mountaineering activities at the Mount Guiting-Guiting Natural Park in Romblon have been suspended from Nov. 1 this year to Jan. 31, 2027, to allow the rehabilitation of the mountain’s flora and fauna. In a notice, the Mt. Guiting-Guiting Natural Park Protected Area Management Office (PAMO) said regular mountaineering operations would resume on Feb. 1, 2027. READ: Sibuyan park board voices grave concern over mining applications The temporary closure is intended to give the park’s natural ecosystems time to recover from the impacts of ecotourism, which the management office said had heavily affected its flora and fauna.
